headline: Revenue climbs to a new high while quarterly profit cools
summary_short: Revenue rose to $11,633M (+14.4% y/y, +3.6% q/q) while diluted EPS of $2.97 gained 10.4% y/y but slipped 5.4% q/q as net income fell 6.5% quarter over quarter.
summary_long: Revenue of $11,633M rose 14.4% y/y and 3.6% q/q. Operating income of $7,130M gained 15.4% y/y but eased 1.4% q/q; EBIT of $7,027M rose 10.3% y/y, down 4.4% q/q. Gross profit of $8,895M gained 8.5% y/y, down 2.6% q/q. EBITDA of $7,394M rose 10.5% y/y, down 3.8% q/q. Net income of $5,628M gained 6.8% y/y but fell 6.5% q/q. Diluted EPS of $2.97 gained 10.4% y/y, down 5.4% q/q; basic EPS matched diluted at $2.97, down 5.7% q/q.
